# Mimris

Mimris keeps AI-assisted project work connected to the domain model.

Mimris connects:

- graphical modelling and metamodelling
- domain descriptions
- functional models
- work items
- documents, decisions, and implementation context
- AI-assisted draft production

Primary page:

- https://mimris-site.vercel.app/

Press kit:

- https://mimris-site.vercel.app/press.html

Documentation:

- From Metis to Mimris: https://mimris-site.vercel.app/metis-legacy.html

Public demos:

- Mimris Modeling App: https://mimris.vercel.app
- Mimris AI Workspace: https://mimris-ai-workspace.vercel.app

GitHub:

- Mimris Modeling App: https://github.com/Mimris/mimris
- Mimris AI Workspace: repository is not public; use the public demo and combined overview for public references.

Launch feedback:

- Mimris and Mimris AI Workspace feedback: https://github.com/Mimris/mimris/issues/30

Positioning:

- Mimris provides the graphical modelling and metamodelling foundation.
- Mimris AI Workspace extends that foundation into structured project execution.
- The shared idea is that AI-assisted project work needs persistent structure across models, documents, work items, and implementation context.
- The primary proof path is the sample coffee-shop workspace: inspect the End-to-End Store Flow and follow links across Order Entry, Payment Checkout, Production Routing, Inventory Ops, domain documents, and work items.
- Diagrams.net helps users draw diagrams; BPMN and UML express known modelling languages; Mimris lets users define the domain language and keep its concepts connected to ongoing project execution.

Primary audiences:

- Builders using AI coding tools who need durable project context
- Teams modelling domains, workflows, documents, and business processes
- Consultants, analysts, product teams, and technical founders working on domain-heavy projects
- Open-source and AI tooling communities interested in model-driven workspaces

Share and directory summary:

Mimris combines an open-source graphical modelling/metamodelling app with Mimris AI Workspace, a public demo of a structured project workspace for keeping concepts, documents, decisions, work items, and AI-assisted drafts connected.

Short listing summary:

Keep AI-assisted project work connected to the domain model.
